title: Marketing Campaign Manager
description:
Marketing Campaign Manager

Warwick Hybrid Working Competitive Salary £TBA + Bonus + Comprehensive Benefits

You will like

Creating engaging, commercially focused marketing campaigns for a market-leading international manufacturer of premium bathroom, sanitaryware and building products, renowned for quality, innovation and design excellence.

Based from Warwick HQ with hybrid working, you'll join a well-established, financially strong global organisation operating across the bathroom, plumbing, construction and home improvement sectors, where Marketing plays an important role in supporting customers, sales growth and brand development.

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious Marketing Campaign Manager / Marketing Manager who wants genuine ownership, variety and visibility combining creative campaign development with digital marketing, content, CRM, retail activity, events and commercial collaboration.

You will like

The Marketing Campaign Manager role itself, working closely with the Head of Marketing to develop and implement channel marketing strategy and deliver the annual marketing plan.

You'll become an expert in your channels, customers and markets, developing creative, engaging campaigns with a clear focus on ROI and commercial results.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Developing and delivering integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels.
- Supporting implementation of annual marketing and communications plans.
- Creating compelling campaign concepts, content and copy.
- Managing campaigns to agreed timescales and budgets.
- Delivering social media marketing activity and digital content.
- Creating brochure, print and wider marketing collateral.
- Reviewing international marketing materials and adapting content for UK audiences.
- Using CRM to engage, nurture and communicate with new and existing customers.
- Developing website and email marketing content.
- Working with external creative, digital and marketing agencies.
- Supporting retail partners and showroom marketing projects.
- Delivering events, exhibitions and sector-specific marketing activity.
- Partnering closely with Sales teams to provide responsive, commercially focused marketing support.
- Engaging directly with customers to understand their needs and marketplace.
- Monitoring campaign effectiveness and contributing to monthly KPI reporting.
- Keeping ahead of marketing, digital, customer and industry trends.

NB: Detailed job description plus salary and benefits information can be provided to shortlisted candidates prior to interview.

You will have

To succeed as Marketing Campaign Manager, you'll be a creative yet commercially minded marketer with at least 3 years' broad marketing experience and a proven ability to turn ideas into effective campaigns.

You will have:
- Experience developing and implementing integrated marketing campaigns.
- Strong copywriting and proofreading skills across digital and print.
- Social media and digital marketing experience.
- Experience implementing marketing communications / Marcomms plans.
- Confidence working collaboratively with Sales and commercial teams.
- CRM and customer engagement experience.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisation, project management and attention to detail.
- A creative, energetic and hands-on approach.
- Commercial awareness and a clear appreciation of campaign ROI.

Experience within a related sector such as bathrooms, sanitaryware, plumbing, building products, construction products, interiors, kitchens or home improvement would be particularly advantageous. We're equally interested in talented B2 B marketers from other product-led environments who can quickly understand technical products, customer channels and routes to market.

Experience of website content management, email campaigns/contact cycles, agency management and events would also be beneficial, as would a CIM marketing qualification or Marketing-related degree.

You will get

As Marketing Campaign Manager, you'll enjoy:
- Competitive Salary £TBA (upon shortlist)
- Attractive 6% performance-related bonus.
- Comprehensive company benefits package.
- Contributory Pension (6% Employer / 4% Employee).
- 37.5-hour working week.
- Flexible working culture.
- Hybrid working from Warwick HQ.
- Early finish on Fridays.
- Opportunity to join a market-leading global manufacturer.
- Exposure across Marketing, Product Management, Sales and senior leadership.
- Excellent long-term professional and career development.
- Supportive, collaborative and professional working environment.

You can apply

To this Marketing Campaign Manager position by pushing the button on this job posting, or by sending your CV in confidence to (url removed).

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive

£30,000 Nuneaton

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Marketing Executive to join an established, market-leading consumer brand, supporting the delivery of engaging marketing campaigns across multiple channels.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a commercially minded marketer who enjoys managing projects, coordinating campaigns and working with creative agencies to bring marketing activity to life. You'll work closely with teams across Marketing, Sales, Trade, Communications and Product Development, gaining exposure to a broad range of projects and the opportunity to take ownership of your work.

The Role
- Coordinate and deliver integrated marketing campaigns across brand, trade, retail and other channels.
- Manage marketing projects from initial briefing through to final delivery, ensuring deadlines and objectives are met.
- Write clear, effective briefs for external creative and marketing agencies, managing their output to ensure high-quality delivery.
- Support brand campaigns, channel activation and premium product launches.
- Work collaboratively with internal stakeholders across Sales, Trade, Product Development and Communications.
- Coordinate the development of marketing assets, promotional materials and campaign content.
- Contribute to copywriting and the creation of engaging marketing communications.
- Use Canva to create and adapt marketing materials where required.
- Monitor project progress, coordinate stakeholders and ensure marketing activity is delivered to a high standard.

About You
- Previous experience in a marketing role, ideally within a B2 C environment.
- Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
- Experience briefing and working with external agencies.
- A good understanding of brand marketing, integrated campaigns and channel activation.
- Excellent written communication skills, including copywriting and preparing marketing briefs.
- Confident working with stakeholders across different departments.
- Experience using Canva and coordinating creative assets.
- A proactive, commercially minded approach, with strong attention to detail and a passion for delivering effective marketing campaigns.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £30,000.
- In-office for the first 4 month probation then hybrid working
- A 35-hour working week: Monday to Thursday, 9am-5pm, and Friday, 9am-4pm.
- 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
- The opportunity to work across a variety of marketing channels, campaigns and product launches.
- Excellent exposure to cross-functional teams and external creative agencies, providing opportunities to develop your marketing career.

At Gleeson Recruitment Group, we embrace inclusivity and welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We are proud to be a disability confident employer.

By applying you will be registered as a candidate with Gleeson Recruitment Limited. Our Privacy Policy is available on our website and explains how we will use your data.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive

IT Networking & Security

Ideal Candidate Location - 1 hour of Coventry - Hybrid Working

Birmingham, Coventry, Northampton, Leicester, Rugby, Stratford, Warwick

Up to £40,000 Basic Salary + Bonus + Other benefits
- Are you a full mix B2 B marketing professional with experience working in a technical field?
- Do you have hands on experience in campaign management, content production, website maintenance & development, AI leveraged marketing operations?
- Are you keen to work for a fantastic company that is going through a period of renewal and expansion?
- Do you enjoy lead generation marketing and being rewarded for the ROI you help generate?

If you can answer yes to the above, this is a role for you!
Our client is looking for a driven Marketing Executive who wants to get hands-on and really get stuck into this brilliant company's digital revamp.

Your Role as a Marketing Executive:
- A hands-on role in a small marketing team, where most of the marketing output is produced in-house rather than via agency.
- Responsible for producing content and materials: web content, sales and customer collateral, case studies, web news stories, customer newsletters, factsheets and product release notes for direct and channel sales.
- Responsible for keeping product manuals, FAQs and other customer-facing technical content current and fit for purpose.
- Responsible for managing and extending integrated direct marketing campaigns: building contact lists, defining message sets, producing and automating campaign messages and workflows, and analysing performance. You will be accountable for the quantity and quality of leads generated.
- Responsible for the ongoing maintenance and development of the company's websites and microsites, including content publishing via WordPress and AI-supported HTML/CSS/JS, ongoing design improvement, SEO, PPC optimisation and LLM citation strategy. Web leads are the key route to the company's growth objectives.
- Responsible for building and maintaining a library of AI tools and workflows that multiply the team's output, such as writing and design engines, research tools, campaign generators and performance analysis. This is expected to be a significant differentiator in the role.
- Monitoring, analysing and reporting on campaign, website and content performance, using the data to improve lead generation, conversion rates, content effectiveness and sales support.
- Contributing to social media campaigns and to the overall direction of the web presence, with scope to take on more of this responsibility over time.
- Contributing to product strategy and product management, including analysis of market segments, geographies, pricing, channels and technologies, and developing tactical plans to position the products.
- On a more occasional basis: major content projects for new products and market initiatives, advanced animated sales presentations and webinar material, and material supporting partner marketing, PR, lobbying, advocacy and events.
- Working as part of the company's senior team. In the short term, you are likely to become either the strong number two to the marketing lead or the lead yourself.

Ideal Background for the Marketing Executive:
- 2 years+ B2 B marketing experience with technical products and or services
- Demonstrable hands-on use of AI in marketing; not occasional drafting, but specific examples of tools or workflows you have built and what they changed.
- A fluent copywriter with a solid portfolio, able to quickly absorb a technical proposition and turn it into clear, impactful messaging.
- Real expertise in one or more of copywriting, graphic design and digital marketing, with solid skills across the wider marketing mix.
- A proven ability to contribute to marketing strategy, with a track record of measurable campaign success.
- A rigorous, structured and data-driven approach to complex problems, including drawing well-judged conclusions from market assessments. This is likely, but not necessarily, backed by a strong degree.
- Highly organised and self-sufficient, bringing your own process and discipline, with a track record of delivering on commitments.
- A direct, confident communicator, written and verbal, who says what they think, backs it up and can deliver uncomfortable information clearly.
- A strong team player with the drive, energy and tenacity to thrive in an entrepreneurial SME rather than a large corporate environment.
- Right to work in the UK without sponsorship.

The Company recruiting for the Marketing Executive:
- A UK-headquartered technology company developing specialist IT products for niche technical markets.
- Established for over 20 years, with customers in over 150 countries; more than 90% of sales are outside Europe, with the USA a key market.
- Their flagship product is the world leader in its niche, with significant growth opportunities in education and other high-value sectors worldwide.
- Run as a true marketing-led business, with a CEO who has vast experience in B2 B strategic marketing.
- Going through an exciting period of renewal and expansion, including new ventures in edtech and AI-driven business automation.
- A proven track record of developing people quickly and rewarding outstanding performance.

The Package for the Marketing Executive:
- Up to £40,000 Basic Salary
- Half-Yearly Performance Bonus
- Hybrid Working
- Pension Scheme
- Clear Career Progression into Marketing Leadership
- Additional Company Benefits

Please apply for this job online if you are interested and feel you fit the above criteria.
John Ahearne is the main point of contact for the role.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive
- Location: Coventry
- Working: Hybrid
- Salary: Up to £40,000 basic salary + bonus + benefits

About the Role

Our client is looking for a driven and commercially minded B2 B Marketing Executive with experience working with technical products or services. This is an opportunity to play a key role in a digital transformation, taking ownership of marketing activity and directly contributing to lead generation and business growth.

This role offers significant scope for progression. As the company grows, the successful candidate could develop into the number two within the marketing function or take responsibility for leading the function directly.

About You

We're looking for someone who combines strong marketing fundamentals with a genuinely hands-on approach.

You'll ideally have:
- At least 2 years' B2 B marketing experience, preferably working with technical products or services.
- Do you have practical experience across campaign management, content creation, website development and maintenance, and AI-enabled marketing?
- Demonstrable experience using AI in marketing, with examples of tools, systems or workflows you have implemented and the results they delivered.
- Excellent copywriting skills and the ability to understand complex technical propositions and turn them into clear, compelling messaging.
- Strong expertise in at least one of the following areas: copywriting, graphic design or digital marketing, alongside a good understanding of the wider marketing mix.
- A track record of contributing to marketing strategy and delivering measurable campaign results.
- A structured, analytical and data-driven approach to solving complex problems.
- The ability to research markets, interpret information and make well-reasoned recommendations.
- Excellent organisation skills, with the independence and discipline to manage your own workload and deliver against commitments.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to communicate ideas clearly and challenge when necessary.
- A proactive, energetic and entrepreneurial approach, with the ability to thrive within an SME environment.
- A genuine interest in using technology and new tools to improve how marketing is delivered.

Key Responsibilities
- Join a small, hands-on marketing team where the majority of marketing activity is managed and delivered internally.
- Create a broad range of marketing and sales materials, including website content, customer and sales collateral, case studies, news articles, newsletters, product information and release updates.
- Ensure product manuals, FAQs and other technical customer information remain accurate, relevant and up to date.
- Plan and deliver targeted marketing campaigns, including database development, audience segmentation, messaging, campaign automation and performance tracking, with responsibility for generating high-quality leads.
- Manage and develop the company's websites and microsites, including WordPress content, HTML/CSS/JavaScript updates, design improvements, SEO, PPC and emerging AI/LLM search strategies.
- Develop and use AI tools and automated workflows to improve marketing productivity across content creation, design, research, campaigns and reporting.
- Track and evaluate campaign, website and content performance, using insights and data to improve lead generation, conversion and sales support.
- Support social media activity and help shape the company's wider digital presence, with opportunities to take increasing ownership over time.
- Assist with product and marketing strategy by researching target markets, regions, pricing, sales channels and emerging technologies, and helping develop effective product positioning.
- Support larger projects when required, including new product launches, major content initiatives, presentations, webinars, partner marketing, PR, events and industry activities.
- Work closely with the senior leadership team and play an increasingly important role within the marketing function, with the potential to progress into a senior marketing position or lead the function.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Job title Marketing Manager

Contract type Fixed-term contract

Working pattern Hybrid (office and remote)

Salary Competitive

Focus areas Customer journeys and engagement, owned and paid campaign delivery, acquisition and switching, payments growth, and programme delivery

About the role

We are looking for Marketing Managers to plan and deliver marketing on a contract basis. Each role will focus on a mix of the areas below, depending on business priorities:
- Customer journeys and engagement: improve onboarding and in-life journeys so customers become active and do more with us.
- Campaign delivery: take campaigns from brief to live across owned and paid channels.
- Acquisition: win new customers, including switching and premium product acquisition.
- Payments growth: increase debit card and digital wallet usage.
- Programme delivery: keep internal teams, partners and agencies aligned and delivering to plan.

The role suits an organised, analytical marketer who is comfortable with data, manages several workstreams at once and turns insight into campaigns.

Key responsibilities
- Customer journeys and engagement
- Map the new customer journey from sign-up and find where customers drop off.
- Design onboarding communications that drive activation, first card use and digital wallet set-up.
- Review in-life communications, identify gaps and overlaps, and build triggered, data-led journeys for key customer moments.
- Deliver campaigns that encourage customers to hold and use more products.
- Work with CRM and data teams on segmentation, targeting and journey set-up.

Owned and paid channel delivery
- Deliver campaigns across owned channels, such as email, push notifications, website and direct mail.
- Deliver campaigns across paid channels, such as paid social, paid search, display and partner media.
- Turn campaign plans into briefs, timelines and channel schedules, and keep delivery on track.
- Coordinate approvals and launch checks, working with compliance and risk teams so communications meet regulatory requirements.
- Manage day-to-day work with agencies and internal creative teams.

Acquisition

Deliver campaigns that encourage customers to switch to the product and make it their main way to pay.

Run incentive and prize draw campaigns from launch to close, including entry communications, terms and conditions, and winner communications.

Deliver owned and paid campaigns that acquire new customers into premium card and payment propositions.

Track switching, activation and acquisition volumes, and suggest improvements.

Payments growth: debit and digital wallet

Deliver campaigns that encourage customers to use their card for everyday payments.

Drive digital wallet adoption and usage, from set-up to first transaction.

Analyse spend and transaction data to find opportunities and measure campaign results.

Work with product and payments teams on offers, incentives and messaging.

Programme delivery and governance
- Build and maintain the integrated programme plan, with milestones, dependencies and owners, and flag delays or blockers early.
- Run programme governance, including steering meetings, status reporting and the RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies).
- Coordinate briefs, timelines, reviews and approvals across internal teams, partners and agencies, with clear handovers and ownership.
- Act as a point of contact for programme updates and escalations, and track spend against the agreed budget.

Performance and reporting

Track engagement, retention, product-holding and channel metrics, and share results and learnings.

Produce regular performance reports and dashboards for marketing leads and senior stakeholders.

What you'll bring

Essential

Marketing, CRM, campaign or programme experience in payments, fintech or financial services.

Experience delivering campaigns across owned and paid channels, including lifecycle, onboarding or engagement activity.

Strong analytical skills, with confidence using data to find insights and report on performance.

Good organisation and planning skills, and the ability to manage several campaigns or workstreams at once.

Experience working with stakeholders across internal teams, partners and agencies.

Clear written and verbal communication.

Desirable
- Knowledge of premium product acquisition, or prize draw and incentive campaigns.
- Understanding of debit card and digital wallet products and customer payment behaviour.
- Experience with journey mapping, CRM or marketing automation platforms.
- Experience in a PMO, programme management or implementation role on marketing programmes.
- Knowledge of financial services marketing regulations and working with compliance teams.

Package & working arrangements
- Salary: Competitive
- Contract: Fixed-term contract. Length and start date to be confirmed.
- Working pattern: Hybrid, with time split between the office and home.
